arguments.code:
async ({ shell: { exec } }) => {
  const script = String.raw`
ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pit-raw-XXXXXX); mkdir -p $ROOT/home $ROOT/agent $ROOT/work
S=$ROOT/tmux.sock; NODE=$(dirname "$(command -v node)"); P=$PWD
BASE="env -i PATH=$NODE:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$ROOT/home PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=$ROOT/agent TERM=xterm-256color LANG=C.UTF-8 PI_OFFLINE=1 PI_TELEMETRY=0 node $P/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/bundle/cli.js -ne -e $P/src/index.ts -e $P/test/support/raw-call-provider.js --no-skills --no-context-files --no-prompt-templates --offline --provider raw-fixture --model fixture --session-dir $ROOT/sessions"
cd $ROOT/work
tmux -S $S -f /dev/null new-session -d -s raw -x 110 -y 60 "$BASE; exec sleep 86400"
sleep 6; tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw "run options fixture" Enter; sleep 4
tmux -S $S kill-session -t raw
tmux -S $S -f /dev/null new-session -d -s raw2 -x 110 -y 60 "$BASE --continue; exec sleep 86400"
sleep 6
echo "== resumed"; tmux -S $S capture-pane -p -t raw2 | grep -E '›|✓|✗|REPLAY'
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw2 C-o; sleep 1.5
echo "== resumed expanded"; tmux -S $S capture-pane -p -t raw2 | sed -n '/›/,/REPLAY/p'
tmux -S $S kill-server; rm -rf $ROOT
`;
  const r = await exec(script, { timeoutMs: 60000 });
  return r.stdout.slice(-4000) + r.stderr.slice(-500);
}
arguments.label: Check a recovered @pit call renders correctly after resuming the saved session
